correctness.rationale: From printed Eqs. (6)–(7), dx/dt=x(π_gs−[xπ_gs+(1−x)π_gw])=x(1−x)(π_gs−π_gw) identically. Eq. (19) deletes (1−x). Its government bracket at (x,y,z)=(1,0,1) is B_g−C_g+C_weak, because yz=0 and 1−z=0. The published Table 3 gives 3−5/2+3/2=2, so dx/dt=2>0 at x=1, while original replicator velocity is zero. By local continuity, any differentiable solution of the reduced drift starting there has x(t)=1+2t+o(t)>1 for small t>0. This is a rigorous counterexample to forward invariance of [0,1]^3. The x-identity and boundary substitution were separately reconstructed symbolically in SymPy; finite evaluation supports but does not replace the exact argument. The argument is deterministic only and does not infer SDE behavior from an ambiguous stochastic notation.
